Lead 2026-10-05 (summary migration gaps):
1. ReportView serves per-participant values for every role (M, B and D), not just D (lane-s26, in the p0-report fixes).
2. ReportView serves the level contrast from eyes4s LevelContrastStat (estimate, paired n, unpaired) with a ref. Studio never counts paired n (lane-s26).
3. The n range ('2-17 queries per participant per group') is served by eyes4s (the range CR6d's ReportFacts already derives), with a ref. Studio takes no min/max.
4. The participant table's overall column may come from a second report() on the spec with groupBy removed. That is an eyes4s evaluation of an explicit derived spec, and its refs name that spec.
